message:
Partial refunds are fixed, and `npm test` passes (20/20), including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.

The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. The header comment says `percent` is 0–100, but the code multiplied the amount by it directly. A 50% refund on 1250 came out as 62500 instead of 625, and a 100% refund came out as 125000. I changed the calculation to divide by 100:

```js
amount: Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)
```

Rounding is unchanged. Nothing else in `src` calls `partialRefund`, so the one-line change is the whole fix. I didn't commit it.
